name: Easter Green
lede: Easter Green is a bright, light yellow-green from the xkcd 2010 color-naming survey, pairing the holiday modifier "Easter" with plain green.

sections.title: A holiday modifier on green
sections.body: Easter Green pairs the modifier "Easter," the color often tied to spring grass and dyed eggs, with [[green]] [1]. The name comes from the xkcd 2010 color-naming survey, where thousands of visitors typed free-text names for colors shown on screen; who first typed this particular pairing is not recorded in our data [1]. Nearby in our color library sit [[lighter-green]], [[baby-green]] and [[light-lime]], all close in hue but lighter or duller [1]. The hex value, #8CFD7E, is a crowd-typed screen color, not a measured pigment or dye [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive shows this color covering at least one percent of its canvas, within CIEDE2000 4 of it, as photographed [2]. That describes this archive, not painting as a whole, and a bright crowd-sourced green like this one is simply rare among historical pigments [2].

origin.named_after: the Easter holiday, paired with green
